capability: Pure per-completion classification policy for the platform momentum curves (Useful Output Rate + Self-improvement Rate): decides whether one completed work item counts as useful / throttle_skip / improvement.

input.state.result_json: the completed item's result envelope (summary, findings, memory_candidates, files_changed, spawn_tasks, sharpening_pct)
input.context.skip_patterns: optional list of regex strings overriding the built-in scheduler-throttle patterns
